gloss: filleting a fish into three pieces

definitions.gloss: filleting a fish into three pieces (two fillets and the backbone)
definitions.explanation: The basic Japanese way of cutting up a fish: the two side fillets are cut away from the backbone, leaving three pieces.

examples.japanese: {鯵|あじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三枚|さんまい}おろし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{三枚|さんまい}おろし⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: Filleting a fish into three is a basic cooking skill.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頼|たの}めば→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三枚|さんまい}おろしにして⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: At the supermarket, they will sometimes fillet the fish for you if you ask.

notes:
From {三枚|さんまい} (three pieces) + おろし, the noun of おろす (to cut up a fish). Also written {三枚|さんまい}{下|お}ろし.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おろす: to fillet ... into three pieces
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{三枚|さんまい}おろし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fillet ...

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{二枚|にまい}→二枚：30347_nimai⟧おろし: cutting into two pieces (one fillet still on the bone)
- {五枚|ごまい}おろし: cutting a flatfish into five pieces
